note: Quote is from xAI's own announcement page; the Aug 12, 2026 date is the page's header date, not part of the quoted sentence. Secondary sources (DataNorth AI) also state 'released 12 August 2026' and say the page is the official xAI announcement. AWS's Bedrock post (published 21 Sep 2026) cites the xAI launch as August 12, 2026 and says Grok 4.6 launched on Bedrock on August 18, 2026; that Bedrock date is distribution, not the public release. Pre-launch Musk/Arena target was around August 7, 2026, and was not met. The AWS post refers to 'Grok 4.6 High', which may be a reasoning tier of Grok 4.6; no separate tier date was found, so the record is for the base model. Lab name: secondary sources say xAI rebranded to SpaceXAI after SpaceX's acquisition; the record keeps 'xAI' as given. No limited preview was found; availability appears to have been general at launch (API, Cursor, Grok Build), though the consumer Grok app was not confirmed.
